notes.title: Dev Update: Improving Visual Consistency!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/3987fd20392a32731effd4643bbe839f7ba6b792.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539852/cee4e11c4a4405278040011310da8993d253eb01.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I’ve received a lot of feedback about the visual art style of [i]Presidential Rise[/i], especially around consistency. As a solo developer using AI-generated art, I know it hasn’t always been perfect and I truly appreciate all your honest feedback.[/p][p]That said, I’m currently working on [b]new visual updates[/b], including [b]improved animation and more consistent art direction[/b]. I’m excited to share more with you soon![/p][p]Thanks again for playing and supporting Presidential Rise.[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements - Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you for trying our game demo!

We’ve fixed a critical issue that was preventing some players from starting the game. The latest version of the demo is now live and ready to play. We sincerely appreciate your patience and feedback during this process.

Please feel free to try the game again, and we hope you enjoy the improved experience!

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your support!


🔧 [Hotfix Update – April 21]
A new fix has just been uploaded to resolve the issue that was still preventing some players from starting a new game.

If you’ve already downloaded the demo and are experiencing issues, please try restarting Steam to get the latest build. If that doesn’t help, a reinstall might do the trick.

Thank you again for your incredible patience. I’m doing my best to address these issues as quickly as possible, and I truly appreciate your support and understanding!
